issues.quote: asked Rebecca223 for a hundred dollars
Though you don’t have to cater to a business the way you do a lover.
The Twitter and Instagram feeds on her side monitors raced like crazy.
The feminist community activated at a hundred percent
the feed suddenly blossomed with rainbow-haired avatars like an exotic conservatory
Now it wasn’t her assistants, but Freja’s own fans mass-reporting and slinging mud at the right-wingers
Right-wingers were always a massive headache.
Stupid sad green frogs started popping up in the chat.
Freja kept smiling and selectively answering questions while glancing over at her assistants’ chat. Like it or not, the comments set the tone.
Ultimately, though, the moderators’ help wasn’t needed.
So they were utterly routed by a counterattack
Charging to their idol’s rescue came moms on maternity leave
Plus the men who craved the attention of all the aforementioned women
without even noticing how they were blowing twenty bucks a month or more on Freja
At last, the young woman smiled genuinely.

strengths.quote: And the right business will *always* get it up for you
strengths.why: sharp, cheeky punchline in her voice

strengths.quote: Still, three hundred and eighty... no, three hundred and ninety thousand live viewers was three hundred and ninety thousand viewers.
strengths.why: live recount shows her mercenary focus

strengths.quote: The trolls’ moms didn’t give them more than five dollars for school lunch.
Housewives who, heeding the clarion call of the modern economy, had traded their soup ladles for oversized smartphones.
Not the finest audience if you’re a serious woman sharing the secrets of *true* success, yet a fiercely loyal one.
donations under ten dollars weren’t even making it onto the screen
